# Bagicha Music

Bagicha Music (आपन गांव के बाग बगीचा) is a free, interactive web-based radio station playing classic 70s, 80s, and 90s Bollywood music. 

## Features
- Streams timeless hits from Kishore Kumar, Mohammad Rafi, Lata Mangeshkar, and Asha Bhosle.
- Designed with a deeply nostalgic "village courtyard" aesthetic.
- Completely free with no login required.
- Uses the YouTube IFrame API to stream audio seamlessly in the background.

Website: https://bagichamusic.vercel.app
